source.studyTitle: Volume EM Reconstruction of Spinal Cord Reveals Wiring Specificity in Speed-Related Motor Circuits
source.articleLicense: The author-hosted article states CC BY 4.0; this is an article-level statement and is not treated as a separately verified licence for each supplementary archive.

biologicalScope.scopeNote: One source volume from one larva; reconstruction counts are source-specific object selections, not population prevalence or a complete interneuron census.

CoBLs.selectionContext: Seeded from synaptic inputs onto two motoneurons, then traced for source-reported CoBL morphology and connectivity.

supplementPackages.articleSupplementStatement: Supplemental Information includes four figures, four tables, and three data files.
supplementPackages.assetDecision: Expose direct official repository links only; no archive payload is downloaded or redistributed, and per-package reuse terms remain unverified.

identityAndGeometryBoundary.interpretation: The article establishes a detailed larval-zebrafish spinal SBEM and selected source-reported reconstructions. Until archive members, exact object keys, completeness, source coordinates and reuse terms are verified, the app displays article-level comparative context only, not neuron geometry.
